description: The deposit provides inputs and outputs for Ambitious, Circular and Conservative European district-heating scenarios. Each scenario includes city-level GeoPackage data and a country summary spreadsheet. The provider is Maxime Vrain; Robin Girard; Virginie Dussartre; Nicolas Lhuillier. Coverage: Coverage is EU27 countries and the United Kingdom. The public abstract does not establish scenario horizon, coordinate system or city-boundary definition. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: These are scenario calculations, not measured future outcomes. Boundary definitions and assumptions require the associated paper and files. For simulation it supports comparison of spatial heating-development scenarios and aggregate national assumptions. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
